summary: Eight sources; 64 distinct family identifiers in the union; 19 CENSUS-DRIFT rows. check-plugin-census-equivalence.ts exits RC=0 while three of its eight arms sit at NON-ZERO baselines (A=24, B=8, F=3), and it reads only four of the eight sources - it never looks at GEOMETRY_ELEMENT_TYPES, CommandEventBridge, initTools or the schemas, so CD-01..CD-06 and CD-08..CD-10 are structurally invisible to it. The sharpest finding is four families - structural, grid, rooms, dimensions - whose CommandEventBridge case emits a geometry-free <x>.created notification that NOTHING in the tree subscribes to, and whose plugin ships a Committer class that is NEVER constructed: grep -rnoE 'new [A-Za-z]+Committer\(' over apps/ packages/ plugins/ src/ (node_modules excluded, TESTS INCLUDED) returns zero hits for GridCommitter, RoomCommitter, StructuralCommitter, DimensionCommitter and StairCommitter. Only four committers are ever constructed in production, all at apps/editor/src/bootstrap.render.everything.ts:135-144 - Wall, Slab, Door, Window. door/window are the control case: they too lack a CEB case and an initTools bridge, and their alternate path is proven by an executed construction site rather than asserted by a comment.
